lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I see Ludmilla looking at the hot spring in the distance.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: What are you doing...?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Ludmilla shakes her head and turns to face me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That's a strange question to ask.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Isn't the hot spring where you come to take a soak?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Ludmilla visits the hot spring briefly every morning, but only to inspect all the equipment.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: She has never bathed in the hot spring.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: This makes her previous statement seem rather out of character.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Are you going to just keep standing there staring at me, or what?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I could ask you the same question: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If you want to head in together, I may consider it.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: T-that's not what I came here for...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: So you're not planning on taking a dip?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: How about a little chat, then?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Sure, you go ahead and have a soak. I'll wait outside.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: No, I don't want to keep you waiting.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You seem to have something to say.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Out with it.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You mean, while you're...?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Ludmilla puts down the lantern and unfastens her robe.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I hurriedly turn around and hear the sound of clothes brushing against skin.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'll turn around while you're in there.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You don't have to do that.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Ludmilla lounges in the hot spring with a contented grin.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: The water's nice and warm.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It's not too late to join me.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm good...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hehe. Anyway, what is it that you wanted to tell me?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's a bit of an odd question:

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I was curious why you suddenly wanted to take a bath in the hot spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I figured that'd be it.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Do you know why this place is called Snowfield Hot Spring?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: The meaning of its name?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Because it's a bastion of warmth, even though it's covered in snow?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It's to commemorate all of those who have had to endure these endless winters while attempting to reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: My hope was that they could feel a semblance of warmth while they were up here, so I named this place Snowfield Hot Spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I've been trying to ensure that it lives up to that name.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That it can be a place where everyone can come and rest.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: So that's why you're so persistent with checking the equipment each morning.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Then a certain someone told me

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: that I should be able to enjoy my time here at Snowfield.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: After giving it some thought,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I started to wonder if everyone was spending their time here comfortably.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: And that's why you came to take a bath?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Seeing other people enjoy themselves was satisfying,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: but I wouldn't necessarily call it relaxing.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I couldn't neglect my duties either, so that's why I'm using the hot spring at this hour.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Now that everyone is asleep, I don't have to be responsible as the owner of Snowfield Hot Spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Is that answer satisfactory for you?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: What are you doing...?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Are you sure you're able to turn off from work mode entirely?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: ... You drive me up the wall sometimes, you know that?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Fine, let me correct myself.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: The reason I waited until everyone was asleep to take a bath was

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: to see if I could switch off my work-oriented mindset and not worry about being the owner of Snowfield.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: But it's not as simple as flipping a switch.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I keep thinking about the one person here who isn't comfortable.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You're talking about Lumi, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Does this have to do with the fainting spell she had back at the dormitory?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It's not just that.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It was on the night we'd held the festival.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I met Lumi on the walking trail.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You know what she said to me?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Help me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: She was practically paralyzed with fear.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Servant, you said you'd help me uncover the legend of this place, did you not?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I don't think we can wait much longer.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: We have to find out what's going on,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: and figure out the truth behind Lumi's past.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Only by doing that can we assure that everyone is enjoying their time here at Snowfield.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: There is a rustling sound as I hear Ludmilla putting her robe back on.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Once she has finished, she speaks to me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I hope you have read through that guest list.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That's where the truth is hidden.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: The truth...

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Pondering over Ludmilla's words, I end up arriving at the dormitory before I know it.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I immediately start rummaging for the guest list,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: and soon find it lying in a corner.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "We promised to make a wish together on the walking trail next time."

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: This is where I left off last time.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After briefly glancing at the photo of Lumi's family, I start carefully reading through the pages.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Upon initial inspection, nothing stands out as particularly special,

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: but Ludmilla insists the truth is hidden in these pages.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: 20 pages in...

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "It's the end of the year."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "The notes provided in the bamboo forest have almost run out. Seems a replenishment is needed."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lua said she'd tie up a wish with Lumi before all the notes ran out."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "That she'd pray for our parents in heaven, and for us."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "It was all a lie."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "It was late, so I told them to do that tomorrow."

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: With an ominous sense of trepidation, I turn the page.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lumi was hurt badly."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lua said it was because Lumi had slipped in the rain on the way back to the dormitory."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Another lie."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "She said it was Lumi's own fault to be so careless, and that she'd take over with night patrols temporarily."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "More lies."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "I'll tell her where to head on patrol tomorrow."

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I flip the page.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The blocks of text are so dense that they almost cover over the names of the guests.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "I had a patrol with Lua and told her what needed to be inspected."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Our first stop was the bamboo forest."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "There was a note tied by Lumi and Lua yesterday that read:"

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "May our family be happy forever."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Yet more lies."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Next, we stopped by the walking trail."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Scores of leaves had fallen in the hot spring, most likely due to the heavy rainfall we've been having."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "As I was tidying the place up, I thought about my wish."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "For my beloved sister."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "May she be happy forever."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "When I made that wish, the red hot spring whispered to me."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "They told me that my wish would come true."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "My beloved sister, Lumi,"

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "would be happy forever."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "After the walking trail, we decided to check out the waterfall."

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The rest of the handwriting is illegible.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After several pages, some neatly written sentences appear again.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lumi's tormentor is no more."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "No more lies."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "The red hot spring made my wish come true."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "My beloved sister, Lumi."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "May you be happy forever."

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: On the next page...

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lumi is gone."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lumi."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Lumi. Lumi. Lumi."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "My beloved sister."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Where are you?"

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Didn't we promise each other"

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "we'd make a wish together on the walking trail?"

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "Is the reason you left so that you could keep your promise to me?"

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "You must be patient with me, Lumi."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "I always keep my promises."

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: That is the end of what is written in the guest list.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: As I close the book, I look back at the family photo which had fallen out before.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: "The Happy Lumi Family".

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: With some effort, I tear my eyes away, and hurriedly head towards the walking trail.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Contrary to what I thought, Ludmila is not there.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: However, a voice echoes from across the hot spring.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Lumi mutters to herself while staring into the water.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Help me.
